summary: Animated multi-agent workflow on a pixel canvas: a planner fans work out to four agents and a verifier merges the results.

events.name: run
events.description: Fires when a run starts, from the button or from `run()`.

events.name: done
events.description: Fires when the verifier finishes. `seconds` is the elapsed run time, rounded to one decimal.

methods.description: Starts the workflow. Ignored while a run is in progress.

accessibility: The phase text below the canvas is an `aria-live="polite"` region that announces each step (planning, dispatching, agents done, verifying, done).
The "Run workflow" control is a native button; it has `aria-disabled="true"` while a run is in progress, so it keeps keyboard focus, and is relabelled "Run again" afterwards.
motion: With reduced motion, spark bursts are skipped, the phase text swaps without the roll and the idle shimmer holds still; node pulses and packets still animate during a run.
notes: The workflow is fixed demo content: one planner, four agents (`explore`, `edit`, `test`, `docs`) and a verifier. Each agent takes a random 1.6 to 3.1 seconds per run.
The canvas is 212px tall and takes the full width of the host; node positions are recomputed on resize.

data.note: The planner, the four agents and their run times are invented; nothing can be set.
